## 미니게임스
### 0.1.7 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added toy Russian Roulette with solo cash-out, 2–6-player matches, and revolver animations using player skins.
* Added solo Snake with a craftable arcade cabinet, Arrow/WASD controls, and configurable rules.
##### Fixed
* Fixed slot machine levers opening the GUI instead of starting a round.
##### Improved
* Improved arcade machine textures, wood joints, game markings, and MWENT table inlays.
* Improved slot machines with rotating item drums, gradual reel stops, and animated levers.
